qa_pairs.question: How can a researcher gain access to the free SHARCNET Abaqus license?
qa_pairs.answer: To gain access to the free SHARCNET Abaqus license, researchers must contact technical support. In their email, they need to mention that the request is for use on SHARCNET systems and include a copy/paste of the Academic License User Agreement statement with their full name and username entered in the indicated locations. Every user, including PIs who have purchased dedicated tokens, must complete this individually.

qa_pairs.question: On which Alliance systems can the free SHARCNET Abaqus license be used?
qa_pairs.answer: The free SHARCNET Abaqus license can only be used on SHARCNET hardware. This includes the SHARCNET OpenOnDemand (OOD) system for running Abaqus in graphical mode, or the Nibi and Dusky clusters for submitting compute batch jobs to the queue.

qa_pairs.question: What are the specific conditions outlined in the SHARCNET Academic License User Agreement for the use of SIMULIA Academic Software?
qa_pairs.answer: The SHARCNET Academic License User Agreement specifies that SIMULIA Academic Software, when used with tokens from the SHARCNET license server, must only be used on SHARCNET hardware where it is installed, in affiliation with a Canadian degree-granting academic institution, for education, institutional, or instruction purposes, and for experimental, theoretical, and/or digital research work primarily aimed at acquiring new knowledge of phenomena and observable facts, up to the point of proof-of-concept in a laboratory. It explicitly prohibits use for commercial or contract-related purposes where results are not publishable.
